items.exampleEn: Everyone who works must pay tax.
items.exampleZh: 每個有工作的人都必須繳稅。

items.exampleEn: The school has a fund for poor students.
items.exampleZh: 學校有一筆幫助清寒學生的基金。

items.exampleEn: My uncle gives financial advice to small shops.
items.exampleZh: 我叔叔為小商店提供財務建議。

items.exampleEn: The hotel charges extra for breakfast.
items.exampleZh: 這家飯店的早餐要另外收費。

items.exampleEn: The new law protects consumers from bad products.
items.exampleZh: 新法律保護消費者免受劣質產品之害。

items.exampleEn: Her income is enough for a small apartment.
items.exampleZh: 她的收入足夠負擔一間小公寓。

items.exampleEn: I can't afford to take a long holiday this year.
He worked hard to pay off his debt.

items.sentenceEn: There is no charge for children under five.

items.audioEn: The museum is free on Sundays, but it charges five dollars on other days.
items.audioZh: 博物館星期天免費，其他日子收五美元。
items.questionZh: 星期一去博物館要付多少錢？

items.sentenceEn: Students often can't afford to eat out every day.
items.sentenceZh: 學生常常負擔不起每天在外面吃飯。

items.sentenceEn: Many families save money to stay out of debt.
items.sentenceZh: 許多家庭存錢以免負債。

items.stemEn: The company has serious ____ problems, so it may close.
items.stemZh: 這家公司有嚴重的財務問題，所以可能會倒閉。

items.stemEn: Many young people can't ____ to buy a house in the city.
items.stemZh: 很多年輕人買不起城市裡的房子。

items.passageEn: Jun is a university student with a small income from a part-time job. Rent is expensive, so he can't afford to eat out often. Instead, he cooks at home and only gets a takeaway on Fridays. Last year, he used his credit card too much and got into debt. Now he reads books about financial planning. The government also has a fund that helps students pay their fees, and he has applied for it. He hopes to finish school without any debt.
items.passageZh: Jun 是一名大學生，打工的收入不多。房租很貴，所以他負擔不起常常在外面吃飯。他改成在家煮飯，只有星期五會買外帶。去年他刷卡刷太多，欠了債。現在他會讀理財規劃的書。政府也有一個幫學生繳學費的基金，他已經申請了。他希望畢業時不欠任何債。

questions.questionZh: Jun 什麼時候會買外帶？
政府的基金是幫學生做什麼的？

referenceEn: Is tax included in this price?
rubricZh: tax 表示「稅」，一般當不可數名詞
「含稅」可寫，例如 include tax、tax is included 等
問句注意助動詞與語序

items.instructionZh: 用 consumer 造一個句子，說說消費者的某種習慣或需要。
referenceEn: Most consumers compare prices before they buy something.
rubricZh: consumer 表示「消費者」，可數名詞
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）
